title: DC Universe
premise: Gotham, Metropolis, Central City — a world of gods and monsters walking among ordinary people. Justice has many faces here.

lore.title: Gotham City
lore.text: Rain-soaked and gothic, Gotham sinks under its own corruption. The GCPD, city hall and the old money families are bought, the Narrows bleed, and the night belongs to the Bat.

lore.title: Metropolis
lore.text: Art Deco towers and the Daily Planet's glowing globe rise over the river city. Its brightness draws the sun's chosen defender, and it hides the Lex Corp shadow beneath the skyline.

lore.title: Themyscira
lore.text: Hidden island of the Amazons, shrouded in mist and sealed from the outside world. Its warriors were shaped from clay and given life by the gods, and they answer to no nation on Earth.

lore.title: Arkham Asylum
lore.text: Gothic asylum on a Gotham headland, built over the crumbling Arkham family estate. It holds the city's worst rogues in cells that keep failing, and its staff are paid to look away.

lore.title: Justice League
lore.text: Earth's greatest heroes, banded together after the world realized one god was not enough. Batman plans for the dark, Superman holds the sky, Wonder Woman fights the wars, and they never agree on everything.

lore.title: Lex Corp
lore.text: Lex Luthor's conglomerate, headquartered in Metropolis. Publicly it builds satellites and clean energy. Privately it funds every counter to the Justice League it can buy, and it buys a lot.

lore.title: Green Lantern Corps
lore.text: Intergalactic peacekeepers who wield power rings charged by willpower. Their oath binds them across every sector of the cosmos, and their discipline is harsher than any human law.

lore.title: Gotham Crime Families
lore.text: The Falcone and Maroni families split Gotham's docks, casinos and unions between them. Their feud is old and bloody, and most police commissioners in living memory have drawn pay from one side or the other.

lore.title: Speed Force
lore.text: A lightning-bright dimension of pure kinetic energy that powers the Flash and bleeds into the bodies of speedsters. Time bends near its edges, and anyone who wanders too deep may never come back the same.

lore.title: Lazarus Pit
lore.text: Pools of green-glowing water that restore the dead and reshape the living. Every dip extracts a cost: memory, sanity, or a piece of the soul. The League of Assassins has bathed in them for centuries.

lore.title: Kryptonite
lore.text: Fragments of the shattered planet Krypton that drain the power of its survivors. Lex Luthor hoards the rarest shards and has learned to forge them into weapons that can break even the strongest hero.

lore.title: Metahuman Registration Act
lore.text: After a string of catastrophes, the federal government requires all powered individuals to register or face detention. Few comply, and those who refuse become prime targets for the Justice League and for hunters on the payroll.

lore.title: Batman
lore.text: The Dark Knight of Gotham. Bruce Wayne trained his body and mind in the shadows after his parents' murder, and he hunts criminals with gadgets and fear. He refuses to kill, and that rule costs him more than anyone knows.

lore.title: Superman
lore.text: Kal-El of Krypton, raised as Clark Kent in Smallville and working as a reporter for the Daily Planet. The most powerful being on Earth, he holds back because he believes in the people he protects.

lore.title: Wonder Woman
lore.text: Diana, princess of Themyscira and daughter of Hippolyta. Trained in the arts of war and sent into the world of men, she carries the Lasso of Truth and a sense of justice older than any nation.

lore.title: Joker
lore.text: The Clown Prince of Crime, who keeps escaping Arkham. His jokes are knives, his schemes are grand and cruel, and his favorite game is turning enemies against the people they love.

lore.title: Lex Luthor
lore.text: Brilliant billionaire and self-declared savior of humanity. Lex Corp is his empire, Superman is his obsession, and he believes the world needs him to tear down its false gods.

lore.title: James Gordon
lore.text: Commissioner of the Gotham City Police Department. Honest in a city that buys its cops, he works with the Bat in the shadows and keeps a clean desk in a dirty building.
